caption: Turning gut checks into data-driven decisions for ideas. This carousel provides five prompts to evaluate value, risks, and next steps. Which idea will you test with this framework first? #AI #Entrepreneur #Productivity #DecisionMaking

slides.title: Stop relying on gut checks
slides.body: Problem: gut judgments mislead decisions. Promise: five prompts to evaluate ideas with AI, improving outcomes.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose fit
slides.body: Prompt: Assess problem-solution fit for {idea_description} with {market_data}. Output: score 0-100 and top 2 risks.

slides.title: 2. Expand criteria
slides.body: Prompt: Expand the criteria to weigh impact, cost, time-to-value, and risks for {idea_description}. Output: criteria list with scores.

slides.title: 3. Apply to idea
slides.body: Prompt: Apply to {idea_description} using the diagnostic score and criteria. Output: one-page decision brief with recommended action.

slides.title: 4. Check risks
slides.body: Prompt: Run scenario tests and bias checks on {idea_description}. Output: list of 3 edge-case scenarios and 2 bias risks.

slides.title: 5. Refine workflow
slides.body: Prompt: Propose a concise, testable guardrail and next steps for {idea_description}. Output: 3 concrete next steps and a guardrail.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: This framework turns a gut call into a scored, testable decision with clear next steps.
